pr_body:
process-util: handle pidfd_spawn() returning E2BIG

In some kernels (specifically, 5.4) even though the clone3 syscall is
supported, setting CLONE_INTO_CGROUP is not. The error message returned
in this case is E2BIG.

If posix_spawn_wrapper encounters this error, it does not retry, and
cannot spawn any programs in said kernels.

This commit adds a check for the E2BIG error and retries pidfd_spawn()
without the POSIX_SPAWN_SETCGROUP flag.

Originally, this issue was reported in https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1077204.

Fixes #33613
pr_comments:
> In some kernels (specifically, 5.4) even though the clone3 syscall is supported, setting CLONE_INTO_CGROUP is not. The error message returned in this case is E2BIG.

Hmm, but this is neither documented nor sane behavior, no? Has this been raised to kernel/glibc folks first?

Hmm, https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20240808-clone3-shadow-stack-v8-8-0acf37caf14c@kernel.org/ suggests that this is indeed considered valid for clone3(). I wonder glibc should document this properly or convert the errno to e.g. EINVAL. But this patch makes sense nonetheless then.
I'm pretty sure this is actually a glibc bug - it's failing because it's setting `clone_args.cgroup` unconditionally even on kernels where it's not available, instead of taking the fallback.

I think kernel/glibc behaviour does make some sense, and yes, we should handle this gracefully, i.e. try to disable the POSIX_SPAWN_SETCGROUP flag, then try again, and if it works now, cache this fact.
@kkourt Could you squash the two commits? I do not think the change should be split into two.

> @kkourt Could you squash the two commits? I do not think the change should be split into two.

Sounds good. Squashed the commits and moved the declaration of the boolean up as requested.
